description: Frontend JavaScript code for VoltSurge SPA handling CSV upload, session management, dashboard rendering, and API interactions.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl
methods.description: Constructs the base URL for API calls, trimming trailing slashes.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Updates the upload status message and tone.

methods.name: setHealthPill
methods.description: Updates the health indicator pill with status text and style.

methods.name: formatNumber
methods.description: Formats a number with specified decimal digits or returns a placeholder if invalid.

methods.name: safeJsonStringify
methods.description: Stringifies an object with indentation, fallback to string on error.

methods.name: httpJson
methods.description: Performs a fetch request, parses JSON, and throws error on non-OK responses.

methods.name: parseCsvHeader
methods.description: Extracts header row from CSV text, handling BOM and trimming.

methods.name: renderHeadersChips
methods.description: Displays CSV headers as visual chips.

methods.name: findBestHeader
methods.description: Finds the best matching header from candidates based on similarity.

methods.name: fillSelect
methods.description: Populates a select element with header options and a placeholder.

methods.name: setSelectValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a select element if it exists among options.

methods.name: canUpload
methods.description: Checks if CSV file and column mappings are ready for upload.

methods.name: updateUploadButton
methods.description: Enables or disables the upload button based on readiness.

methods.name: resetDashboardUi
methods.description: Resets session and dashboard UI elements to initial state.

methods.name: renderSummary
methods.description: Displays session summary statistics.

methods.name: renderAlerts
methods.description: Displays list of anomalies as alerts.

methods.name: renderChart
methods.description: Renders energy time-series chart with anomaly highlights.

methods.name: refreshSessionFromBackend
methods.description: Fetches session data, summary, anomalies, and updates dashboard.

methods.name: uploadAndProcess
methods.description: Uploads CSV file, initiates session, and updates dashboard.

methods.name: testHealth
methods.description: Checks backend health status.

methods.name: clearSession
methods.description: Deletes current session and resets UI.

methods.name: resetAll
methods.description: Resets file input, mappings, and UI to initial state.

methods.name: onFileSelected
methods.description: Handles CSV file selection, reads header, and sets default mappings.

methods.name: wireEvents
methods.description: Attaches event listeners to UI elements.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes event wiring and UI state on script load.
